# Introduction and Schedule {.unnumbered}

## Introduction

Welcome! On this website, you will be able to find all materials needed for the successful completion of your thesis.

This website was created by me, your supervisor - Lucija Sorić. It exists to simplify our workflows and offer a centralized platform that is easy to find (it is just one link!) and easy to share (still just one link!).

Some parts of this website are static, and unlikely to undergo major change. For example, contact details will always remain the same.

Other aspects, such as research materials, instructions, meeting summaries, and others, will be updated at the appropriate time. The [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) section](https://soriclucija.github.io/thesis-info/faq.html) will be updated regularly, as more questions come in. This way, I am trying to ensure all of you can benefit from shared information, even if you were not the one to ask it.

Thanks for reading and looking forward to working with you!

## Schedule

Below you can find the preliminary schedule. Upon changes, this will be updated.

For the sake of transparency, I have included both your tasks and my tasks in the schedule. If you want to see either one of them by itself, click the buttons below.

```{=html}
<script>
function filterColumns(view) {
  const tables = document.querySelectorAll('table');
  const table = tables[tables.length - 1];
  const rows = table.querySelectorAll('tr');

  rows.forEach(row => {
    const cells = row.querySelectorAll('th, td');
    if (cells.length < 4) return;
    const studentCell = cells[2];
    const supervisorCell = cells[3];

    if (view === 'all') {
      studentCell.style.visibility = 'visible';
      supervisorCell.style.visibility = 'visible';
    } else if (view === 'student') {
      studentCell.style.visibility = 'visible';
      supervisorCell.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    } else if (view === 'supervisor') {
      studentCell.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      supervisorCell.style.visibility = 'visible';
    }
  });

  // Toggle "active" class on buttons
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-buttons .btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('active');
  });
  document.getElementById('btn-' + view).classList.add('active');
}
</script>
```
